messages:
rachel: Hey team — opened PR #912 with updated SDK snippets for streaming + function-calls. Need 2 reviewers; target merge before release cutoff at 18:00 PT today. Vercel preview is erroring with a missing ENV for API_HOST so the examples render broken. Can someone take a quick look? :pray:

build-bot: preview-deploy: https://vercel.com/redwood/docs/preview/912 (status: failed)
build-bot: error log excerpt:
```
Error: process.env.API_HOST is undefined
at renderExamples (/vercel/path0/docs/helpers/sdk-snippets.js:42:27)
```

devon: @rachel I can look. Likely the preview context doesn't have the project secret set. For vercel we often set `VERCEL_ENV` specific vars in the preview target. Did you add a fallback in the snippet renderer?

anika: :eyes: If it's just rendering examples, we can ship docs-only but previews must be green for the release notes link. Quick options: 1) Add a safe default in the renderer when ENV missing (localhost stub) 2) Set a temporary secret in Vercel preview context 3) Attach an integration check to mark it docs-only and merge with approval.

rachel: I added a small helper that reads API_HOST from env and does no-http calls when absent. It works locally because I have .env. Locally I run:
```
cp .env.example .env
npm run docs:dev
```
But I didn't include a fallback which causes build failure. I'll push a tiny fix to use `process.env.API_HOST || 'https://playground.redwood.dev'` in helper and re-run.

docs-bot: link-check: started for PR #912

sean: Quick heads-up for reviewers: the streaming snippet uses the new client API `client.streamChat` — please confirm wording around backpressure/aborting. Also flagged the function-calls example to ensure it matches the runtime contract.

rachel: Pushed fix `add-api-host-fallback` — re-triggering preview. Also added dev instructions to PR description: how to run the docs renderer with sample env.

build-bot: re-deploy preview: https://vercel.com/redwood/docs/preview/912 (status: building)

devon: For local repro with same env behavior:
```
# simulate preview env
API_HOST=https://vercel-preview.example mkdocs build
npx http-server site -p 8000
```
And if you want to test snippet rendering only: `node scripts/render-snippets.js --host https://vercel-preview.example`

anika: The fallback looks fine. One tiny nit: the streaming example logs tokens with `console.log(token)` which might be noisy; suggest `if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') console.log(token)` instead.

sean: Reviewed SDK wording. LGTM after the log nit is addressed. I can approve once fixed.

docs-bot: link-check: 0 broken links found (after last commit)
build-bot: preview-deploy: https://vercel.com/redwood/docs/preview/912 (status: success)

rachel: Preview is green — thanks. Assigning reviewers: @sean and @devon for final ok. If both approve and CI passes, I'd like to merge before 18:00 PT.

sean: Approved.
devon: Approved, left one small comment on the sample header comment.

release-manager: Confirmed: release window open until 18:00 PT. Docs-only merges ok if both reviewers approve and preview is green. Please add [docs-only] to the PR title and ping me before merging.

rachel: Added [docs-only] and pinged release-manager. All green; merging now.

build-bot: PR #912 merged by rachel (docs-only): https://github.com/redwood-inc/docs/pull/912

rachel: Backported the small redirect for an old snippet link and updated the release notes link. Thanks everyone! :tada:
